chapter_theme: One song at Thiruvanmiyur (திருவான்மியூர்): the poet confesses he wandered in union with women of no virtue instead of seeking Murugan, and asks for the lotus feet; the praise names Murugan as the expert who gave knowledge into Siva's two ears.

698.reading: The poet describes women with mountain breasts, thread-thin waists, carp eyes and moon faces who have no virtue, and confesses that, a base man, through desire for their arms he wandered in union without seeking Murugan, and asks for the shining lotus feet so that he does not perish on this famed earth. The praise names Murugan the nephew of Narayana, the expert who gave the treasure of knowledge into Siva's two ears, death to the demons, and the son of Siva worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu and Indra, at Thiruvanmiyur of jewelled mansions.
698.nuance: அரன் இருகாதிலே உதவு நிபுணா: the teaching of Siva is placed in his ears, without naming Om. மடிவாய் இறாத வகை may ask that he not die before reaching the feet; the phrase is hard to divide. ஆலமயில் அமுதேசர் may name the shrine's Siva.
